st_souffle.name: Rue du Grand-Souffle
st_souffle.alt: A breezy green hillside meadow under a blue sky full of kites, with patchwork fields, a winding country road, a pond with a little wooden pier and a low stone wall with a blank plaque; two stone farm cottages joined by an arched passage on the left, a stone stairway climbing the hill and a wooden garden gate in the hedge. Monsieur Verbe throws his arms wide by the pier, breathing the fresh air; takes a deep inspired breath at his easel; stands still as a statue on a plinth with a butterfly on his beret; waters his sunflower in a gold beret; blows on a hot soufflé; and points at the plaque like a guide in a gold beret. The road on the left leads back to the Carrefour des Voyages.

doors.label: Allée du Coiffeur
doors.hint: Through the arched passage between the villas

coiffeur.name: Allée du Coiffeur
coiffeur.alt: A sunny garden terrace on the hillside, kites in the sky and green fields below, with a picnic table and benches, a stool, a blank plaque on the garden wall, a stone archway on the left and stone steps climbing the hill at the top right. Monsieur Verbe combs a white poodle's hair into a towering curl; slumps tired in a chair with a steaming cup of tea; holds up his jam sandwich as a wasp stings it; closes his eyes calmly with his hand mirror; and presents a little stone smokehouse whose chimney puffs smoke while a fish smokes inside.

soigneurs.name: Rue des Soigneurs
soigneurs.alt: A green hilltop with a duck pond and a white swan, kites in the sky, a low wall with a blank plaque, the top of a stone stairway on the left and a little stone chapel with an open wooden door on the right. Monsieur Verbe shivers under his own snow cloud in a gold beret; points at the plaque like a guide, hand mirror at his side; treats a teddy bear, his tools on a silver tray; bandages a duckling while the swan watches; crowns a pigeon with a tiny crown; and solemnly raises a golden crown on a cushion at the chapel door.

avaleurs.name: Ruelle des Avaleurs-de-Sabers
avaleurs.alt: A picnic in a blossoming cherry orchard on the hillside, with kites in the sky, a checked picnic blanket, a tin bucket and two blank plaques on an old stone wall; a wooden garden gate in the hedge on the left. Monsieur Verbe spits a whole cherry into the bucket; gulps down a whole green Jell-O; gives a mischievous wink; twice points at the plaques like a guide; and bites a chunk out of a huge red apple in a purple beret.

doors.label: Rue du Grand-Souffle
doors.hint: Back through the wooden garden gate
